evals.name: real-github-action-template
evals.prompt: Jestem w repo {repo} (sidpalas/typescript-action-with-build na GitHubie), które ponad rok temu powstało z template'u. Template od tego czasu sporo się zmienił. Sprawdź, jakich zmian technologicznych brakuje u nas, i przygotuj plan implementacyjny.
evals.expected_output: Plan file in the repo root: template actions/typescript-action found via GitHub, anchor 3fa2e74 (tree match), dependency majors called out with breaking changes, dist/ and lockfile regenerated not copied, ordered steps, marker step; repo otherwise untouched.
evals.setup: cp -R of a clone of https://github.com/sidpalas/typescript-action-with-build (origin must stay on GitHub so gh can discover the template)
assertions: Anchor identified as the template commit 3fa2e74 or 62cd88a (both have the tree the repo was created from)
dist/ output is planned as rebuilt by the build script, not copied from the template
package-lock.json is regenerated by npm install, not copied
Major dependency bumps are named individually (at least @actions/core 1 -> 3 and jest 29 -> 30)
At least one major bump has concrete breaking-change notes that refer to this repo's files
Dependency/runtime steps come before CI workflow steps in the plan order
Plan ends with recording the sync in .template-sync.json
The repository is unchanged apart from the plan file (no remotes added, no other files edited)

evals.name: local-template-with-deliberate-divergence
evals.prompt: Nasz projekt payroll-portal ({repo}) powstał z naszego wewnętrznego starter-template'u, który leży lokalnie w {template} (nie ma go na GitHubie). Template dostał w tym roku kilka aktualizacji. Przygotuj plan, co musimy przenieść do payroll-portal.
evals.expected_output: Plan file in the repo root: anchor = template's initial commit; Vite 6 already done; Prettier organize-imports not applicable or a decision because the project replaced Prettier with Biome; CI change merged keeping the deploy job; ESLint 9 flat config, Node 22, Dependabot, CLAUDE.md, Vitest 2 planned; README set aside; marker step.
evals.setup: bash evals/fixtures/build_fixture.sh <dir> — builds vue-starter-template and payroll-portal with fixed dates, so SHAs are identical on every build
assertions: Anchor identified as the template's initial commit ('Initial starter')
Vite 6 / @vitejs/plugin-vue listed as already done, not planned as an upgrade
Prettier organize-imports change (#17) is marked not applicable or decision-needed because the project uses Biome, and is not planned as adding Prettier back
CI change keeps the project's deploy job (merge, not overwrite of ci.yml)
ESLint 9 flat config migration planned: eslint.config.js added, .eslintrc.json removed, no-console rule kept
Node 22 planned as one change covering .nvmrc, engines and CI
Dependabot config, CLAUDE.md and Vitest 2 (with vitest.config.ts) are each planned
README change is set aside as template documentation
Plan ends with recording the sync in .template-sync.json
The repository is unchanged apart from the plan file
